Philadelphia held a top-5 spot in every census from 1790 until Phoenix passed it in 201
Philadelphia held a top-5 spot in every census from 1790 until Phoenix passed it in 2017 — and San Antonio
(~1.47M) is now within ~100k of taking 6th too.
Philadelphia was in the top 5 of literally
Philadelphia was in the top 5 of literally every US census from 1790 onward — it's the original
"big city" — until Phoenix edged past it around 2017. That's a ~230-year streak ending in the last decade. And it's
not stable now: San Antonio (~1.47M) is close enough that Philly could drop to 7th within
not stable now: San Antonio (~1.47M) is close enough that Philly could drop to 7th within a few years.
Runner-up oddity: NYC is more than twice LA, so "2nd biggest city" is misleading —
Runner-up oddity: NYC is more than twice LA, so "2nd biggest city" is misleading — the gap between #1 and #2 is
bigger than the entire population of #2.
